edits.original: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.reason: 'on purpose rather than by accident' is an ordinary-knowledge antonym trailer, but the phrasing (with the parenthetical 'a dwarfing tradeoff' from the source) makes me unsure whether it maps cleanly to the Rule 3 pattern; flagging rather than silently cutting.
